description: This source file contains architecture-specific functions for task context management, task startup, and register handling for an AUTOSAR platform, specifically targeting the HCS12D architecture. It includes functions to initialize the architecture, set task entry points, retrieve stack pointers, and handle supervisor mode switches.

methods.name: void Os_ArchFirstCall(void)
methods.description: Enables interrupts and calls the first task entry point to switch to supervisor mode if necessary.

methods.name: void * Os_ArchGetStackPtr(void)
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack pointer value using inline assembly, specific to the IAR system.

methods.name: unsigned int Os_ArchGetScSize(void)
methods.description: Returns the size of the execution context in words.
